subject: UNSTRING statement
notes: GR18 / Annex A.2 item 61 leave overlapping UNSTRING operands undefined (cite.py --check -> OK 14.9.48.4 18), A.2 61), 4.4 2)). Owner decision 2026-10-01 (kb/Work PB1907): document the behavior, follow GnuCOBOL 3.2 where it measurably differs, pin it. docs/CONFORMANCE.md D-UNS1 to D-UNS4: the statement runs in place - sender and identifier delimiters are re-read before each later receiving area wherever a store (INTO, DELIMITER IN, COUNT IN) can reach them (StorageSharing.MayShare), DELIMITER IN receives the live delimiter content, a DELIMITED BY ALL run of repeats is consumed after the receiving area's INTO store over the sender and delimiter as that store left them (CobolStringOps.UnstringSkipRun, StringEmitter.EmitAllRun; kb/Work PB1909), TALLYING adds the count to its content at the end and is stored before the POINTER, which is read once and stored last. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Runtime/Verbs/CobolStringOps.cs#MatchedDelimiterIndex (deleted by PB1909: UnstringExtract now returns the matched delimiter's list position itself, so nothing guesses it back from the delimiter text)
